cards.title: How to Support a Child Interested in STEM
cards.body: Parent support is critical for helping children develop interests in STEM and succeed in STEM classes. Here are five accessible ways parents can support their kids in STEM.

cards.title: The Link Between Youth Loneliness and Smartphone Dependency
cards.body: Smartphone dependency, loneliness, and AI companionship are reshaping youth relationships, with potential consequences for mental health and social development.

cards.title: What Stressed Teens Need During College Application Season
cards.body: Two therapists couldn't get their stressed teen to slow down. What finally helped wasn't more advice—it was asking one question and listening carefully to the response.

cards.title: What Every Parent Should Know About Campus Sexual Assault
cards.body: Parents can maintain an open dialogue with their children about sexual safety on campus and encourage colleges to implement programs to end sexual violence.

cards.title: My childhood was one of survival and resilience
cards.body: Start with the feeling, not the activities when modeling a joyful life for kids. Making more room for enjoyment is also making more room for your actual self.

cards.title: I used to think I had impeccable taste in music
cards.body: My kids taught me to stop being a snob about music. Music may not define them in the way it defined my generation, but my children still know a good tune.

cards.title: Secondary school teacher to crofter - life on UK's remote island
cards.body: Katy Phenix relocated to Fair Isle from North Yorkshire with her partner Josh Moore and their children Teddy, 11, and Hetty, six. The family adapted to life on one of the UK's most remote locations.
